items.description: When you take in the view east of our hotel, just past I-75, you'll see rustic fields and warm countryside; to the west, the burgeoning city of Lima, Ohio. Here at Holiday Inn and Suites Lima, we take pride in maintaining that balance between 'Downtown' and 'Down-home'. Welcome to the Holiday Inn and Suites, Lima, Ohio's newest full service hotel. Our property proudly boasts of The Lounge, our restaurant and full bar, which provides room service to all 116 beautifully appointed, newly renovated rooms and suites. After dinner, relax in our indoor heated pool and hot tub or burn off those calories in a fully equipped workout room. With 2400 square feet of versatile meeting space we're here to help you celebrate wedding vows or reminisce over drinks with former classmates during a reunion. Within minutes of industry centerpieces such as Ford Engine Plant, Procter & Gamble, the Husky Refinery, Lima Memorial Hospital, Mercy Health St. Rita’s Medical Center, Dana Incorporated, and the Orthopaedic Institute of Ohio, your business trip will be streamlined and efficient. If you’re in town seeking that deal-sealing handshake from a potential client or partner, the local dining scene is the way to impress. Whether it’s steaks at Old City Prime, a gourmet burger and designer cocktail at The Met, hibachi and a Spicy Girl sushi roll at Yamato, or a bottle of wine at Vino Bellissimo (where they also have 36 craft beers on tap!), the only way you won’t impress is if you don’t try.

items.name: Lima
items.pet_policy: Max 1 pet permitted up to 40lbs with a nonrefundable fee of 75 for stays between 1 to 6 days, 150 between 7 to 29 days, and 250 every 30 days. Pet Policy must be signed upon arrival. No fee for service animals. Emotion support animals do not qualify.
items.description: Discover the Holiday Inn Express & Suites in Lima, OH conveniently located right off I-75 Exit 125. Start your day with our complimentary hot breakfast at the Express Start Breakfast Bar. After a day of adventure, relax near the fire pit on our patio or cook a meal at the complimentary grills. During your stay, you will enjoy our well-appointed guest rooms with thoughtful design throughout. Our hotel also offers a 24/7 fitness center, indoor pool, free WiFi, and flexible meeting space for up to 12 people. Whether traveling for business or leisure, the Holiday Inn Express & Suites Lima is delighted to be at your service. We are located just minutes from shopping & restaurants at the Lima Mall and a quarter-mile from Allen County Fairgrounds. Enjoy quick access to the University of Northwest Ohio or The Ohio State University - Lima in less than a 7-minute drive. The Armstrong Air & Space Museum is 15 minutes away, and we're 30 minutes from Findlay or Sidney. Within a short drive of industry centerpieces, you can reach major industries such as Ford Engine Plant, Procter & Gamble, Cenovus Energy Refinery, Lima Memorial Hospital, Mercy Health St. Rita’s Medical Center, Dana Incorporated, and the Orthopedic Institute of Ohio.

items.description: Welcome to Wapakoneta’s newest and most modern hotel, the Holiday Inn Express and Suites. Our guests can enjoy the conveniences of staying at our 100% smoking free facility which is conveniently located off of I-75 at Exit 111. Guests will find Holiday Inn Express & Suites to be just a short drive to local businesses including Pratt Industries, Washington Penn, Kosei, Airstream, Plastipak, Cargill and Wal-Mart. Local attractions near and in Wapakoneta include the Neil Armstrong Air and Space Museum, 5 Vines Winery and Eldora Speedway. The state of the art hotel features modern and spacious guestrooms, microwave and refrigerator, and a 42 inch LED HDTV. Check out our new Express Start Breakfast, to start your day off right. Enjoy our indoor-heated pool and wireless Internet access in all public areas. Whether you are stopping by for business or for pleasure, come join our family and you will discover why our guests continue to choose to stay at the Holiday Inn Express and Suites of Wapakoneta, Ohio.

items.description: Welcome to the Holiday Inn Express Bluffton! Experience a comfortable, modern stay at the Holiday Inn Express Bluffton, ideally located just off I‑75 with convenient access to employers like GROB Systems, SumiRiko Ohio, Tower Automotive, and Diamond Manufacturing. Only minutes from Bluffton University, our hotel is well suited for business travel and family visits. Our hotel is also close to popular local attractions such as Shannon Theatre, Buckeye Park, Bluffton Village Park Shelter House, and the Bluffton University Nature Preserve perfect for enjoying the charm of the Bluffton community. We are pleased to welcome you and are committed to making your stay easy and enjoyable. Start your day with our complimentary Express Start Breakfast, stay connected with free Wi-Fi, maintain your routine in our fitness center, and relax in our indoor pool. Whether you're visiting for work or leisure, our friendly team is here to ensure a comfortable and convenient experience from start to finish. Thank you for choosing Holiday Inn Express Bluffton. We look forward to welcoming you and hope you enjoy your stay in Bluffton, Ohio.

items.description: Stay close to the best of Van Wert, Ohio, with easy access to local parks, entertainment, and events. Visit Franklin Park, catch a movie at Van Wert Cinemas, or enjoy live performances at the Niswonger Performing Arts Center. Outdoor spaces like Delphos Stadium Park and events at Hat Creek Arena add even more ways to explore the area. Just off Highway 30 between Lima and Fort Wayne, our hotel makes travel simple. We’re conveniently located near major employers like Eaton Industries, Cooper Foods, Central Insurance, and Braun Industries, ideal for business trips or combining work and leisure. After a busy day, settle into clean, comfortable rooms designed to help you recharge. Start each morning with free Express Start Breakfast, then take advantage of convenient amenities like an indoor pool, fitness center, and in-room essentials including a microwave, mini refrigerator, and workspace.
